title: alnus incana subsp. rugosa
intro: Alnus incana subsp. rugosa, commonly known as Grey Alder, is a subspecies of the deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the birch family (Betulaceae). The Grey Alder is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Grey Alder include its ability to ease coughs, reduce inflammation, and promote the removal of mucus, making it a valuable natural remedy for bronchitis and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Grey Alder include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
